fixer.title: agentHost: separate PR polling from unchanged repair cooldowns

introducer.title: agentHost: pace Agent Merge CI repair and reset the repair budget on progress

cases.mechanism: The old gate synchronously withheld an otherwise applicable repair prompt for a 10-minute quiet period whenever any sibling check remained pending, putting timer delay directly on the autonomous CI-repair critical path.
cases.symptom: Applicable Agent Merge CI repairs could not start for at least 10 minutes, including when a human-approval check remained pending indefinitely.
cases.fixedBehavior: CI-only Agent Merge prompts are evaluated and dispatched immediately; only an identical already-dispatched repair fingerprint observes the separate 10-minute retry cooldown.
cases.evidence: In the base revision, line 1092 computed `_getCIRepairHold(runtime)` for CI-only prompts; the helper delayed work until checks had been unchanged for 10 minutes (and up to a 60-minute maximum hold). This PR deletes that hold path, and the added pacing tests show a failed CI check now starts immediately even while an approval/other workflow remains pending.
